source_title: Micron Fiscal Q3 2024 Earnings Call Prepared Remarks
server_unit_forecast_visible_text: industry server unit shipments are expected to grow in the mid to high single digits in calendar 2024
researcher_paraphrase: Micron expected 2024 industry server units to grow and separately reported that customers had announced multi-year AI-server roadmaps with annual product cadence; the same section positioned HBM, D5, high-capacity DIMM, CXL and data-center SSD as Micron's relevant portfolio.
precision_guard: The server-unit statement is a contemporaneous expectation, not realized shipment Reality. Customer roadmap cadence is not itself proof of deployment volume, DRAM bits, NAND bits or supplier share. Product adjacency must remain separate from a quantified demand bridge.
authority_boundary: The short preserved phrases are readable representations from Micron's prepared remarks. The local JSON is not raw PDF bytes.
